conclusion: Native evaluation 42 scored both exact whole-view units without replay. Both protected preface readings were missing, and the heading emitted a private false definition candidate without acceptance. The archived release remains readable but did not pass current native admission on the acquired target. Run 407 therefore remains private comparator evidence, not an eligible DMA-13 predecessor.
